meta.title: Automatic Tunnel Car Wash Systems | High-Capacity Machines
meta.description: Automatic tunnel car wash systems for medium and large facilities, with continuous operation and fast throughput of up to 1.5 minutes per vehicle.

hero.title: Tunnel Machine
hero.intro: Built for medium and large facilities, the Tunnel Machine washes vehicles sequentially without interruption, moving a vehicle through the full cycle in as little as 1.5 minutes.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of the WashThru Tunnel automatic car wash machine

features.heading: How the Tunnel Machine Works
features.subheading: A continuous wash line engineered to keep multiple vehicles moving without slowing down.

items.title: Continuous, sequential operation
items.description: Processes more than one vehicle at a time, with no pause between wash cycles.

items.title: Smart Sensors (IPS)
items.description: Reads each vehicle's dimensions automatically so the wash sequence adapts for optimal coverage and performance.

items.title: Pre-wash spray, touchless mode, and crystal foam
items.description: A pre-wash spray loosens dirt, an optional touchless mode speeds up lightly soiled vehicles, and a crystal foam spray covers the entire vehicle.

items.title: Touch-based brush pressure analysis
items.description: Brushes continuously analyze contact to apply the ideal pressure across every panel of the vehicle.

items.title: Ultra-soft micro-foam brushes
items.description: Highly effective at lifting dirt without holding onto grit, paired with an automatic brush-cleaning cycle that keeps every pass safe for the paint.

items.title: Foam rinse and wax finish
items.description: A thorough rinse clears remaining foam, followed by a wax spray that helps maintain the vehicle's shine.

items.title: Over 90% drying coverage
items.description: Additional drying brushes can be installed, and the line is designed to support water-recycling equipment.

items.title: Resistance to natural factors
items.description: Stainless steel is used at every friction point so the machine holds up to dust, humidity, and salinity in the local environment.

items.title: Up to 1.5 minutes per vehicle
items.description: Continuous operation and a longer wash line let the Tunnel Machine sustain a higher throughput than single-bay systems.

advanced.heading: Smart Technology, Built In
advanced.subheading: Every Tunnel Machine ships with the same connected, self-monitoring technology stack.

items.title: Failsafe protection
items.description: Automatically stops the machine partially or fully at the first sign of a fault and reports the issue immediately.

items.title: Auto Tuning technology
items.description: Re-tunes its own operating parameters after every wash cycle, with no manual intervention required.

items.title: API technology
items.description: A supplemental service for partners running their own software, apps, or ERP systems who want to connect them directly to the machine, at a nominal fee and with no extra hardware required.

items.title: Smart Maintenance (SM) system
items.description: Fully connected to WashThru's systems to raise the level of control, monitoring, and maintenance quality.

items.title: Preventive Maintenance (AI) technology
items.description: Continuously monitors every part of the machine and estimates its remaining lifespan, giving partners an early warning before a part nears the end of its service life.

items.title: Wearable part lifespan calculator
items.description: Tracks the remaining lifespan of wearable parts and alerts partners in advance, so replacements happen on schedule.

useCase.heading: Built for Medium and Large Sites
useCase.description: The Tunnel Machine's continuous line is the right fit for busy car wash operators, dealership groups, and high-traffic sites that need to process vehicles back-to-back without ever slowing the queue.
useCase.imageAlt: Illustration of vehicles moving through a continuous tunnel wash line
